title: Will Wright's next simulation will use AI to mine content from your memories
gist: Will Wright (SimCity, The Sims) is promoting MyMems, a generative-AI simulation slated for next year from Gallium Studios and AI middleware firm Artificial Agency that turns players' memories into characters and themed zones. The project revives Proxi, which stalled when Gallium ran out of funding in late 2024; the partnership lets Gallium use off-the-shelf, cheaper-than-frontier AI.

themes.theme: Funding history and AI middleware economics

insights.claim: MyMems began as Proxi, announced in 2018, but Gallium Studios ran out of funding in late 2024, leading to mass layoffs before the project was revived largely through the Artificial Agency partnership.
insights.speaker: Kyle Orland
insights.so_what: AI middleware partnerships can resuscitate capital-starved studios.

insights.claim: Wright says partnering with Artificial Agency lets Gallium use off-the-shelf AI without becoming an AI research company, and is cheaper than really expensive frontier models that would be overkill.
insights.speaker: Kyle Orland
insights.so_what: Demand for cheaper, specialized AI middleware over frontier model APIs in games.

insights.claim: Artificial Agency, previously focused on agentic virtual players for playtesting and companionship, will build a personal behavior model and knowledge graph from players' memories, pitching privacy via local processing.
insights.speaker: Kyle Orland
insights.so_what: Memory-data products invite privacy scrutiny; the local-processing claim is a differentiator to watch.
